facts.text: I checked that AppArmor is on and installed and running/enforcing on my program.
I ran the command "sudo snap debug sandbox-features discord" and it returned an error saying "too many arguments for command".
I ran the command "sudo aa-status" and it showed proper context and that it is a group of processes in "enforce mode".
I did not find a relevant Discord file in /etc/apparmor.d/.
I found that the AppArmor profile exists at a location that was mentioned in the conversation.
